meta.title: Add t.Parallel to metrics subtests
meta.body_summary: Add t.Parallel to metric test subtests for parallel execution; an experiment using Codex noted test failure with 'no route to host'.

perf_labels.notes: Experiment PR; t.Parallel added but test failed due to network; author closed without merge.

change_scale_vs_repository.interpretation: At 18 changed lines in a single test file, this is a tiny edit by absolute volume. It fits a micro-experiment test improvement, but was closed without merge due to the test failing in the author's environment.

review_details.concern_detail: The PR body notes the test fails with 'no route to host', indicating the test environment cannot reach required services, so the change was not viable.
review_details.performance_claim: Adding t.Parallel to subtests allows them to run concurrently, reducing overall test execution time.
review_details.rejection_signals: Author self-closed after noting test failure; no review feedback.

capability_boundary.boundary_notes: Adding t.Parallel is a simple one-liner but depends on execution environment; Codex's change itself is minimal, but the experiment was terminated due to network-dependent test failure.

detection_detail.code_reading: Author ran go test and noted 'no route to host' failure, leading to closure.

maintainer_practices.reproducibility_notes: PR body mentions test fails and gives no performance numbers; no benchmark or before/after timing.
maintainer_practices.regression_detail: PR closed without merge after failure.

core_change_summary.description: Add t.Parallel() calls in Test_SetConfigInfo and Test_SetDBConfigInfo subtests within internal/telemetry/metrics/info_test.go to enable parallel execution.
change_trajectory: Single commit adds t.Parallel to subtests.

collaboration_trajectory: OpenAI_Codex (via author desimone) opened PR as experiment.
PR closed by author ~14 hours later without merge.
